literal.prompt: В аккумуляторном электромобиле какой узел хранит электричество для тягового электромотора?

literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L55 and L71: BEV traction battery pack powers motor and stores electricity for the traction motor; L60, L62, L64 ground same-system alternatives and distinguish their roles.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L55 and L71: BEV traction battery pack powers motor and stores electricity for the traction motor; L60, L62, L64 ground same-system alternatives and distinguish their roles.

literalGroups.literal: Тяговая батарея хранит электричество для тягового электромотора. Для её зарядки автомобиль подключают к розетке или зарядному оборудованию; бортовое зарядное устройство преобразует поступающий переменный ток в постоянный.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L55, L66, L71: traction battery powers/stores electricity for motor; vehicle plugs in; onboard charger converts incoming AC to DC.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L55, L66, L71: traction battery powers/stores electricity for motor; vehicle plugs in; onboard charger converts incoming AC to DC.

literalGroups.literal: Автомобиль подключают через порт к розетке или зарядному оборудованию; при зарядке бортовое устройство отслеживает напряжение, ток, температуру и уровень заряда.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L55, L66: traction battery charges through vehicle connection; onboard charger monitors voltage, current, temperature and state of charge.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L55, L66: traction battery charges through vehicle connection; onboard charger monitors voltage, current, temperature and state of charge.

literalGroups.literal: Вспомогательная батарея электромобиля подаёт электричество на его аксессуары.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L60: auxiliary battery supplies electricity to vehicle accessories.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L60: auxiliary battery supplies electricity to vehicle accessories.

literalGroups.literal: Порт зарядки соединяет автомобиль с внешним источником питания, чтобы заряжать тяговый батарейный блок.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L62: charge port connects vehicle to an external supply to charge traction battery pack.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L62: charge port connects vehicle to an external supply to charge traction battery pack.

literalGroups.literal: Преобразователь DC/DC снижает напряжение постоянного тока от тяговой батареи для питания аксессуаров и зарядки вспомогательной батареи.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L64: DC/DC converter changes traction-pack high-voltage DC to lower-voltage DC for accessories and auxiliary battery.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L64: DC/DC converter changes traction-pack high-voltage DC to lower-voltage DC for accessories and auxiliary battery.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Unique key: AFDC says the traction battery stores electricity for the traction motor. The note adds that the car connects through its port and that the onboard charger monitors battery characteristics during charging. Port, auxiliary battery and DC/DC converter are real BEV components but their documented roles do not store traction energy for the motor.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: While the traction battery is charging, the onboard charger monitors battery voltage, current, temperature and state of charge.
correctNoteNewFact.ground: This is additional to the asked storage/power relation and is an AFDC-stated fact specifically about charging the correct traction battery pack.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceKnowledgeGround: The question tests component-level knowledge specific to BEVs: a player familiar with electric drivetrains should distinguish the traction battery pack from the auxiliary battery, charge port and DC/DC converter. A player without EV-system familiarity may recognize “battery” but must identify which battery serves the traction motor; all alternatives are genuine components in the same system, and the two battery options make the distinction nontrivial.
